Routines

top source red::make_raw_cube

SST pipeline

red::make_raw_cube, oldname [, /integer], mtf_deconvolve=mtf_deconvolve, neuralnet=neuralnet, nexp=nexp [, /overwrite]

Make a de-rotated and de-stretched time-series FITS data cube with raw data.

Parameters

oldname

Keywords

integer in optional type=boolean

Store as integers instead of floats. Uses the BZERO and BSCALE keywords to preserve the intensity scaling.

mtf_deconvolve
neuralnet
nexp
overwrite in optional type=boolean

Don't care if cube is already on disk, overwrite it with a new version.
